note: Edit-second section boundaries of the 36.000 s cut (picture locked, 1080 frames at 30 fps; sections/durationSeconds/musicHit/fadeOut.start written by ../sync-cues.mjs from ../shots.json). Every sound cue (gust swells, bird placements, lantern, ticks, hamlet creaks, music rise and hit) is placed relative to these; after any retime run node ../sync-cues.mjs (or edit ONLY this file) and re-render. hamlet is optional: drop it and every curve glides from stairs to reveal.

steps.note: surface = the material per section (aliases ok); the game's stairs rule then turns stone into 'stair' when the boot is on the stairs (stairsFrom 'map': the world's stairs mask at the logged pos, as the game does; 'gait': gait 'stairs'; placeholder steps always use the gait); surfaceOverride = forced final surface per section; the row's gait wins over sectionGait; strength per gait; gainDb per section rides after the game's sfx compressor.

music.note: scoreDb = the score over the game's in-game balance; gain / lowpassHz are reached at the END of each section; the section leading into the hit (hamlet) uses preHitGain / preHitHz at hit - 0.35 / 0.4 s.

curves.note: optional per-section overrides of cine.js tables: gust / intimacy take [[anchor 'start'|'end', offset s, value], ...]; canopy / chorusRate / chorusLevel / rustle take one number per section.
